$comment: Targeted scenario to genuinely exercise the tier-stratified ADMM.
Knobs chosen to maximise the chance of multi-tier deficit *within a
single holon* (i.e. across its 4 member groups), which is when
the priority-aware weighting actually distinguishes the allocation:
- simbench_lv_cp_heavy: 342 loads, large enough that holons of
4 groups span hundreds of children across many tiers
- priority_assignment=uniform: each tier 1..10 gets roughly equal
counts (~34 loads each) so community partitions are unlikely to
end up with single-tier modal populations
- line_stress with load_scale=2.2 and ampacity_scale=0.35: hard
enough that the LP shed *will* hit multiple tiers per community
- failure_lambda=4.0, max_failures=8: high failure density so
- 60 s sim: enough rounds for the holon ADMM to fire on multiple
- Both label_prop (tier off) and modularity (tier on) for the
name: priority_admm_targeted
